name: basecamp-translator
description: An English–Spanish translation bot for Basecamp to-dos and comments, by Daniel Ch.
author: Daniel Ch (https://github.com/chddaniel)

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SETUP_PASSWORD.description: Create a unique random password of at least 24 characters. You will use it to sign into /setup. Keep it: encryption of your Basecamp tokens depends on it.

BASECAMP_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from your own [Basecamp OAuth application](https://launchpad.37signals.com/integrations). See the README for the callback URL.

BASECAMP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret for the same Basecamp OAuth application.

TRANSLATION_API_KEY.description: Your Google Cloud Translation Basic API key. Enable billing and the Cloud Translation API in your own Google project. Restrict the key to Cloud Translation API.
